mapper.update: UPDATE kitchen_comment SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS avg_rating, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM kitchen_comment WHERE status = 'NORMAL' AND dish_id = #{dishId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM kitchen_comment WHERE status = 'NORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM kitchen_comment WHERE status = 'HIDDEN'
SELECT rating, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM kitchen_comment WHERE status = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating
